g.text: No ACT# LED: the CH342F QFN24 has no ACT# bond-out.

g.desc: No ACT# LED: the CH342F QFN24 has no ACT# bond-out.

g.text: D3 green LED from VIO (VIO present).

g.desc: D3 green LED from VIO (VIO present).

g.text: CC1/CC2 5.1k Rd to GND so a USB-C host sources 5 V.

g.desc: CC1/CC2 5.1k Rd to GND so a USB-C host sources 5 V.

g.text: R5 1k series on RXD1, R6 1k on CTS1.

g.desc: R5 1k series on RXD1, R6 1k on CTS1.

g.text: J2: GND, TXD1, RXD1 (pin 1 is GND).

g.desc: J2: GND, TXD1, RXD1 (pin 1 is GND).

g.text: EN tied to VIN, always on.

g.desc: EN tied to VIN, always on.

g.text: No jumper: VIO off, bridge in reset.

g.desc: No jumper: VIO off, bridge in reset.

g.text: Do not wire anything to pin 2.

g.desc: Do not wire anything to pin 2.

g.text: PTVS6V0S1UR on VBUS, CC1 and CC2, close to the connector.

g.desc: PTVS6V0S1UR on VBUS, CC1 and CC2, close to the connector.

g.text: LP5907-3.3: 2.2 uF ceramic in and out.

g.desc: LP5907-3.3: 2.2 uF ceramic in and out.

g.text: R_TNOW 4.7k to GND on TNOW0 (auto-direction config). VCC <- VIO (100nF C7).

g.desc: R_TNOW 4.7k to GND on TNOW0 (auto-direction config). VCC <- VIO (100nF C7).

g.text: PRTR5V0U2X rail-to-rail clamp on D+/D- (VCC pin on VBUS).

g.desc: PRTR5V0U2X rail-to-rail clamp on D+/D- (VCC pin on VBUS).

g.text: R8 10k pulls the unused modem inputs RI0/RI1/DCD0/DCD1/DSR0/DSR1 to VIO (inactive).

g.desc: R8 10k pulls the unused modem inputs RI0/RI1/DCD0/DCD1/DSR0/DSR1 to VIO (inactive).

g.text: J4: A, B, GND. R_TERM 120 ohm 1% across A/B. UART0 TTL is not broken out.

g.desc: J4: A, B, GND. R_TERM 120 ohm 1% across A/B. UART0 TTL is not broken out.

g.text: DI <- TXD0, RO -> RXD0. DE//RE tied together and driven by DTR0/TNOW0.

g.desc: DI <- TXD0, RO -> RXD0. DE//RE tied together and driven by DTR0/TNOW0.

g.text: VDD5 <- VBUS (100nF C4), V3 <- 100nF only (C5), VIO <- VIO net (100nF C6).

g.desc: VDD5 <- VBUS (100nF C4), V3 <- 100nF only (C5), VIO <- VIO net (100nF C6).

g.text: VBUS pin <- VBUS net. RST left NC (internal pull-up). EP (pin 25) to GND.

g.desc: VBUS pin <- VBUS net. RST left NC (internal pull-up). EP (pin 25) to GND.

g.text: R9 10k holds CTS0 low (always clear to send) so UART0 flow control cannot stall.

g.desc: R9 10k holds CTS0 low (always clear to send) so UART0 flow control cannot stall.

g.text: USB 2.0 device port, VBUS 5 V in. D+/D- go straight to U1 (no series R).

g.desc: USB 2.0 device port, VBUS 5 V in. D+/D- go straight to U1 (no series R).
